topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Well, now, ain’t this a puzzle. Master Blake, he left the village a moon past, and here comes a letter for him, postmarked from the fair city of Linndale. I found it misdelivered to my door, and thought it best to hold it, just in case. I wonder what could be penned in such a letter, and whether the good master would mind the delay. Should I risk sending word to him, or let the matter lie till the next market day when folks visit? I do worry, for he seemed troubled the last time we spoke, the soil of his old garden heavy on his heart.
